crossRefs.note: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked…
The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night…
If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

parallels.note: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three…
“You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.”

translations.web: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
translations.bsb: So Isaac prepared a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
translations.kjv: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
translations.asv: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
